snippet.title: Fruit Golf - Official Chateau Vampoire Course Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Ever dreamt of putting a pineapple down a pirate ship while your friends go full sabotage with sharks and exploding barrels? Enjoy the chaotic, colorful world and absurd gameplay from Fruit Golf in this trailer for the golf party game in VR. This latest Fruit Golf trailer gives a peek at a spooky new course coming to the game: Chateau Vampoire. Fruit Golf is available on Google Play, Meta Quest, and the App Store. The Chateau Vampoire Course for Fruit Golf will be available on July 17, 2025.
